biotools.summary: NaviDiv is a web application designed to monitor and manage chemical diversity in the generative design of molecules. It provides multi-metric analysis, real-time visualization, and adaptive constraint generation to guide molecular optimization while preserving chemical diversity.
biotools.name: NaviDiv: Chemical Diversity Monitoring Web App
